head: hex with integral star (serrated) washer
notes: NCRS thread (72 side louver nut) says GM 3857243 = side louver stud nut, Paragon 15065K, a #10 nut but poster unsure 10-24 vs 10-32; another reply says the number is a wiper transmission nut kit. Thread left null. Pass 4: use clarified: Zip (68-79 wiper motor mount nuts, secures motor to firewall studs), Dr. Rebuild ('Hex Nut with integral Star Washers to mounts the motor to the firewall') and EC Products (wiper transmission to firewall) all cite GM 3857243. CorvetteParts.com calls it a 'Serrated Washer Head Nut' (68 door push button housing). Only size hint is the NCRS '#10' (pitch unknown); thread left null.
